name: Audrey Sobgou Zebaze
bio: Audrey discovered iOS when she first bought an iPhone Edge in 2008. Since then, she is working passionately on Apple platforms, enjoying SwiftUI and even CoreData while building the macOS Proton Drive app. When she is not coding, watching/playing basketball and football are her favorite activities. As a huge movie addict, Audrey is avoiding trailers as much as possible.
